messages:
Alex: Hey folks, wrapping up week 1 and trying to set up secrets for my new staging service. Quick checklist: how do I request a Vault secret for staging and prod, who has to approve prod, and what simple rotation rules should I follow?

DevEx Bot: Welcome @Alex! Start here: https://redwood.dev/internal/devex/vault-quickstart. Use the vault-request template in #help (or link the GH template). For prod you need an explicit approver (team lead or product owner) and a security sign-off for cross-team access.

Maya: Steps I'll usually give new folks: 1) Draft the vault-request ticket with service name, team, envs (staging/prod), secret path you want, and whether it's static or dynamic; 2) Choose path convention e.g. secrets/teams/<team>/<service>/<env>/<key>; 3) For DB creds prefer dynamic DB plugin; 4) Add approver's Slack handle in the ticket.

Maya: Small example for KV v2 put (dev/staging only):
```
# from dev machine (dev auth)
vault kv put secret/teams/ads/creative-service/staging API_KEY=\"REDACTED\"
```

Liam: A few gotchas: if you need KMS-wrapped keys (long-term encryption), request an AWS KMS CMK in the ticket and include the ARN. For ephemeral signing/encrypting, use Vault Transit. If your service is GCP-hosted, specify the GCP project id and service account so we can configure the IAM auth role.

Maya: Rotation basics: prefer dynamic credentials (no rotation needed from you), for static secrets set an owner and cadence in the request (we default to 30 days for customer-facing API keys, 90 days for internal service tokens unless security requests otherwise). Use vault-agent/template or the SDK to fetch at runtime so images don't bake secrets.

Alex: For prod approver, should I ping my PM or infra lead? Do we ever accept "team@" aliases?

Liam: Named human approver preferred (PM or infra lead). We avoid generic aliases unless the alias maps to a small, documented oncall rotation. If emergency access required, tag @InfraOncall and include justification in the ticket.

Maya: Also: TTL vs lease renewal: for dynamic creds Vault issues a lease; your app should renew if it needs long-lived sessions or re-request when expired. For secrets that must be rotated automatically, set up a periodic job (we can help) or use our rotation service — mention that in the ticket.

Alex: Perfect. I'll draft the ticket now and paste here for review before I submit. Thanks everyone!

DevEx Bot: Template: https://redwood.dev/internal/templates/vault-request. If you paste the draft here, @Maya or @Liam can help edit. :thumbsup:
